task: #119 — Real-compute pretrain smoke test on lambda-labs RTX 4090
purpose: Prove end-to-end dispatch: freshly-trained MODEL-2 tokenizer → encode-corpus → apr pretrain (real-compute) executes on RTX 4090. Not a convergence test.

result.detail: DIVERGENCE at epoch 0: val_loss 18 is non-finite or > 10.0

runs.interpretation: Real-compute path executed (370M loaded on CUDA, forward+backward+AdamW ran on 10 real batches). Val_loss=18 after 10 steps exceeds INV-TRAIN-005 hardcoded 10.0 threshold, triggering GATE-TRAIN-005 ship-blocker. log(50257)≈10.82 is the uniform-random baseline for 50257-vocab; val_loss=18 is ~1.66× baseline, indicating LR drove weights worse-than-random in a handful of steps.

result.detail: DIVERGENCE at epoch 0: val_loss 54 is non-finite or > 10.0

runs.interpretation: Same real-compute path. Val_loss worse (18→54) with 2× more steps confirms training is diverging, not converging. --target-val-loss CLI flag only controls GATE-TRAIN-003 (convergence target) — GATE-TRAIN-005 divergence guard uses INV-TRAIN-005 hardcoded 10.0 threshold from contract.

Synthetic linear-decay drive passes end-to-end with the new MODEL-2 tokenizer dir as --tokenizer input. Proves CLI + loop + run-dir + gates are intact; divergence in the real-compute runs is NOT a loop-plumbing regression.

discharge_status: PARTIAL — dispatch proven, convergence out of scope
what_is_discharged: End-to-end asset chain: task #118 tokenizer → task #123 encode-corpus → task #105 apr pretrain real-compute
RTX 4090 real-compute path (370M model loaded on CUDA, forward + backward + AdamW on real corpus batches)
GATE-TRAIN-005 divergence guard correctly fires on diverging training
what_is_NOT_discharged: Convergence of from-scratch 370M on CSN-Python — requires proper pretrain HP (LR ~1e-4, warmup ~500, steps ~50K+, effective batch ~256)
AC-SHIP2-003/004/005 which need a real 370M APR checkpoint with val_loss ≤ 2.2

followups.problem: The 10.0 val_loss divergence threshold is calibrated for MODEL-1 QLoRA fine-tune (base weights already pretrained). For from-scratch 370M, uniform-random val_loss ≈ log(vocab_size) ≈ 10.82 for 50257-vocab — already over threshold before any training.
followups.proposal: Add a from-scratch regime to INV-TRAIN-005: allow val_loss ≤ 2× log(vocab_size) ≈ 22 for epoch 0-N where the model has not seen enough tokens to converge. Tighten threshold at epoch boundaries. OR: make the threshold a CLI flag separate from --target-val-loss.

followups.problem: apr pretrain --lr default 5e-5 is fine-tuning-tuned (MODEL-1 v2 remedy per CLI help). From-scratch 370M needs ~1e-4 peak + longer warmup.
followups.proposal: Add --mode {finetune|from-scratch} switch that flips LR default + warmup + target_val_loss together, OR document that defaults are fine-tune-only.
